_comment: PHM — Project Hail Mary (Andy Weir 2021 / Lord-Miller adaptation imagined). Cooler/lighter cyan than vigil's Jarvis-saturated teal; reads as 'technical drafting' rather than 'combat HUD'. data._comment: Fully monochrome cyan ladder. PHM reference confirmed via bmg 2026-05-24: the central viewport / data viz area is unconditionally monochromatic cyan-white. The accent colors (yellow/green/orange/red) appear ONLY in chrome pills + warning lines as state indicators, NEVER in data fills. So all 6 cat[*] entries stay inside the cyan-white-to-steel envelope. State colors live in accent.warning / accent.ok / accent.danger and are picked up by gauges + alert chips, not by treemap/vega categorical fills.
